Rooms were described as spotless, with no corners overlooked, and bathrooms had strong water pressure. Many emphasized the high standards of hygiene, even satisfying users with mild obsessive-compulsive tendencies.

Features include spacious, uniquely designed rooms with scenic mountain views from balconies, comfortable beds, soaking tubs, and modern amenities like air conditioning. Some properties also have private pools or family playgrounds.
